label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
definition: Organization X is owned by, a subsidiary of, or an organizational unit of parent Y.
scope_notes: Unit-of, part-of, owned-by and subsidiary-of dominate, preserving the prior child-to-parent organizational containment predicate. Historical ownership qualifies; competition and geographical containment do not.
